mobbin:23ce165d-078b-4adc-935a-83c4a40cb.summary: Traveler opens a trip overview, enters Get ready to fly, then scrolls a Ready to Fly hub of time-gated prep tasks and know-before-you-go items.
steps: Trip overview — route, placeholders for gate/seat
Sheet — Get ready to fly entry CTA
Ready to Fly — countdown + check-in/bags cards
Ready to Fly — TSA / Wi-Fi / REAL ID cards
steal: Single Ready to Fly hub keyed to one event/trip (steps 3–4) — pre-session readiness in one place.
Time-remaining / not-yet-available copy on cards (step 3) — show what cannot be done yet vs what to do now.
Missing-data placeholders (--) on the trip card (step 1) — glanceable incomplete setup fields.
Entry CTA sheet from the trip (step 2) — nudge into the checklist without hunting menus.
avoid: Informational cards without tick/flag/broken states (steps 3–4) — sim-tech equipment-check needs explicit pass/fail, not brochure links.
mobbin:23ce165d-078b-4adc-935a-83c4a40cb.fit: Mobile readiness hub fits walking the floor before a session better than desktop; extend Baseline equipment-check / checklist with time-gated tasks, but add real tick/flag handoff AA lacks.
